methodology.inventory: 47 public templates retained from prior audit; actual source now has 64 page templates including 17 gated/admin/internal templates. Account landing is public; private subpages are checked as supporting journeys.
methodology.before: Current baseline source review, not a copy of prior audit. activePaths and dev-audit lists are not inbound UI links. Wrong/progress/analysis/FAQ had no public inbound CTA.
methodology.after: Rendered visible anchors at 390/1280 plus conditional fish accordion click and source review. Static private paths take precedence over dynamic [id] matching.
methodology.classification: CONNECTED: reachable public route plus useful next/back action. WEAKLY_CONNECTED: unavailable business detail templates with valid parent fallback; no active public records, so no fabricated inbound links. ISOLATED: active page lacking meaningful inbound. The three dormant business-detail templates are explicitly outside the 44 active-node reachability assertion.
methodology.limitations: Connectivity describes navigation, not a new production functional certification. Fresh auth, provider data, GPS and publication are not simulated.
